skills.name: architecture
skills.description: Design and evaluate software architecture for new systems, major changes, and technical-debt decisions. Use when choosing boundaries, components, dependencies, deployment topology, or migration strategies.

skills.name: api-design
skills.description: Design, document, or review HTTP and event-driven APIs, including contracts, versioning, validation, errors, and security. Use when creating endpoints, integrating services, or changing API behavior.

skills.name: backend-engineering
skills.description: Build, refactor, or review production backend services, especially Python APIs and service layers. Use for FastAPI, Django, Flask, service integration, background jobs, and backend reliability work.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review code changes for correctness, regressions, security, maintainability, and test gaps. Use before merging pull requests or auditing a specific diff; prioritize actionable findings over style preferences.

skills.name: database-engineering
skills.description: Design, query, migrate, and optimize relational databases, especially PostgreSQL. Use for schema design, SQL, indexing, transactions, data integrity, and database performance.

skills.name: debugging
skills.description: Investigate defects and unexpected behavior systematically using logs, traces, code, reproduction steps, and tests. Use when a bug is intermittent, unclear, or spans multiple components.

skills.name: devops-cloud
skills.description: Build and operate deployment pipelines and cloud infrastructure safely. Use for CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure configuration, releases, observability, and incident response.

skills.name: frontend-engineering
skills.description: Build and review accessible, responsive frontend applications with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. Use for UI implementation, component architecture, state, routing, forms, performance, and browser behavior.

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.description: Find and improve measurable application, API, database, or build performance bottlenecks. Use when latency, throughput, memory, bundle size, or resource consumption is a concern.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Audit an application, API, repository, or deployment for security vulnerabilities and unsafe patterns. Use before releases, during code review, or when assessing authentication, authorization, data handling, or dependencies.

skills.name: technical-writing
skills.description: Create or improve technical documentation, runbooks, ADRs, API guides, onboarding material, and release notes. Use when technical information must be accurate, scannable, and maintainable.

skills.name: testing-strategy
skills.description: Design and implement reliable automated testing across unit, integration, contract, UI, and end-to-end layers. Use when adding features, fixing bugs, or improving test confidence and CI reliability.

skills.name: ai-integration
skills.description: Integrate LLMs, model APIs, retrieval systems, and AI agents into applications with reliable evaluation, privacy, and safety controls. Use for chat, RAG, tool calling, orchestration, and model-provider abstractions.
